messages:
ana: Quick sync: we have a small kernel ABI + quant bundle scheduled in ~25m. preflight checklist here.

sam: ack, i'll monitor and own rollback if perf worsens.

jules: add rollback criteria: 5xx >0.4% for 3m or p95 up >25% vs baseline for 5m. Also KV miss surge >15% -> rollback.

a: preflight steps: verify artifact checksum, ensure runtime ABI header matches, run lightweight smoke on staging. doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/release/1747

deploybot: deploy queued by ana at 2026-03-22T01:05:00Z to pool:regional-quant. preflight: checksum OK.

sam: note: if deploybot sets sticky-pin, abort and manual rollback. no auto-retry.

a: launch plan: 2% -> 8% -> 30% -> 100%. will pause 10m at 30% to collect traces.

jules: running thermal sweep now. will flag any host above 82% mem.

deploybot: starting canary slice 2% -> 2026-03-22T01:06:40Z.

sam: seeing p95 +11% initially, watching traces for decode loops.

a: hold 3m, then advance if stable.

deploybot: canary metrics @2%: errors 0.08%, p50 +4%, p95 +11%. advance approved.

deploybot: advancing to 8% -> 2026-03-22T01:12:05Z.

jules: thermal ok at 8%. no drains.

sam: moving to 30% after one more check.

deploybot: advancing to 30% -> 2026-03-22T01:18:30Z. hold for 10m for trace collection.

a: collecting traces, will decide after hold. if tail recurs, we rollback to prev-bundle and open IR-1747.

deploybot: rollout paused at 30% for 10m -> collecting telemetry.

sam: tail spike observed on 2 hosts at minute 6 (p95 +30%) but decayed. recorded traces.

a: ok keep paused full 10m. if spike repeats, rollback.

jules: creating post-run note and will schedule a quick 30m follow-up tomorrow.

a: thanks team. leaving this thread open for 24h for any late regressions.
